description: Na₅CoHO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.33 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.39 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to two equivalent H and five O atoms. Both Na-H bond lengths are 2.53 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.56 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.56 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.43 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.37 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.83 Å) and two longer (1.90 Å) Co-O bond lengths. In the second Co site, Co is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.82 Å) and two longer (1.90 Å) Co-O bond lengths. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Co octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-57°. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Co octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-62°. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Co octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 56-62°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Co atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four Na and one H atom.
